scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.check: prettier --check . && npm run check:backend && npm run check --workspace @cekrir/frontend
scripts.check:backend: uv run --project apps/backend ruff check apps/backend && uv run --project apps/backend ruff format --check apps/backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test --workspace @cekrir/frontend
scripts.format: uv run --project apps/backend ruff format apps/backend && prettier --write .
